theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_ga_lc_graph_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + k)) (g : Euclid m → Euclid k) (w₀ : Euclid m), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → DifferentiableAt ℝ g w₀ → fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w₀ = ι.toContinuousLinearMap + ι'.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L fderiv ℝ g w₀ ∧ ∀ h : Euclid m, ‖h‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w₀ h‖
